review.note: Rejected as written; the product is fine (GET /api/resume-outputs/:id/download.docx, server/lib/outputDocx.js writes dc:creator = authors joined by '; ' and dcterms:created = package createdAt; header QR hyperlink target = /r/<slug> URL). Spec resubmission, not a defect. Resubmit as a cli step in an existing journey group (e.g. J6.4, after J6.3 so the resume is approved with <SLUG1>). Give exact commands: download via the signed-in browser's Download .docx button (desktop and 390px) or curl with the session cookie to /var/tmp/qr-demo/resume.docx, then `python3 -I` reading the docx core properties and the header part's relationship Target. Exact expectations: author 'Avery Example; Jordan Sample'; created 2026-09-30T13:00:01; header hyperlink Target equals <BASE>/r/<SLUG1> (the link on the card); created is not 2013-12-23. State which card is used.
